## Overview

This document defines the automated review acquisition system for Bob's published books. Since the pricing ladder conditions price increases on review traction, this system ensures consistent review flow to support pricing strategy.

### Pricing Ladder Logic (Reminder)
- Base price: $4.99 / $9.99
- Price increase triggers: 50+ r
